svg.aria-label: The supporting tools and the question each one answers
svg.title: SPS supporting tools — and the question each one answers
svg.text: The supporting tools, and the question each answers
None of these is a separate system. Each drives the very same pipeline, from a different direction.
BEFORE YOU START · DEPLOYMENT CHECK
Is the service reachable, and its scores sensible?
Runs in seconds. Scores sample problem text so you can see
whether the confidence gates are anywhere near right for
this deployment, before a single ticket is processed.
REVIEWING QUALITY · BULK TEST
Across many tickets, what is it recommending?
Your own sheet of tickets comes back with the recommendation,
the reason and the source records beside each row. Your input
file is never modified, so a run can be repeated and compared.
SETTING THE GATES · BATCH EVALUATOR
Where should the confidence threshold sit?
Reports the score of every case, including the ones that were
rejected — those are precisely the ones that say whether the
gate is in the right place. A pass-only report would hide them.
STANDING DATA · THE STANDARDS LIBRARY
How are the 0250 documents kept current?
Copy the documents into one folder; there is nothing to run.
They are read once and reused. Editing, adding or renaming
one rebuilds the index by itself on the next ticket.
All four drive the same pipeline production uses.
What a test shows you is what a supplier would actually have received — there is no separate
"test mode" whose results might differ from the real thing.
